Light comes ONLY from ancient venom. Calm near-black upper 6% for desktop bar, broad very dark low-detail negative space. Dark areas retain faint irregular painterly grain and mist rather than featureless gradients or banding. No neon, fluorescent slime, heavy bloom, lens flare, orange illumination, bright blue ice, sun, moon, stars, readable runes, text, lettering, signatures, watermarks, borders, interface, franchise likenesses or third-party designs. One small complete translucent glass-like venom teardrop floats at (64%,54%), occupying 22% image width and 40% image height, tip below y=30%. Left side empty near-black softly grained void. Subdued emerald liquid currents and tiny particles inside. Input is Eitr's own emblem, SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its soft asymmetric four-lobed outer contour and precise angular dark internal cutout. Its shape emerges faintly from the liquid currents inside the drop, partially veiled and low contrast, discernible on looking carefully, not a sticker or flat icon. The drop is a separate enclosing shape. Tiny sparse drifting particles. Realistic refraction with subtle dim jade reflections, painterly atmosphere. Extremely restrained glow, minimal lime, dark emerald interior. No other logo or ornament. Mandatory framing: tiny droplet fully enclosed within rectangle x=54% to 74%, y=32% to 72%. Rounded teardrop with a short pointed top, no long liquid stem or connection to frame edge. Entire upper quarter empty darkness. Emblem much fainter than surrounding liquid: interrupt its currents subtly with mist while retaining reference contour.
